title: Widget Explorer hangs plasmashell for a bit when it opens
line: Opening the Widgets sidebar does about 40% less work, so plasmashell's freeze when it appears is shorter, though not gone.
explanation: Every widget shown in the sidebar built two tool buttons, a Kirigami badge and a badge effect with two shader sources, although these only appear on the hovered widget or on a newly installed one. On top of that, the model checked each applet's icon with QIcon::hasThemeIcon, which for applets without an icon of their own makes Qt build its own engine and search every theme directory again. The sidebar delegate now creates the buttons and the badge with Loaders only when they are shown, and the model asks KIconLoader directly. This removes about 40% of the main thread's work on opening; the rest of the first-open stall comes from rendering the applets' SVG illustrations and creating the sidebar's QML, so both commits use CCBUG.

commits.message:
WidgetExplorer: create delegate buttons and badges only when shown

Every widget in the sidebar created two tool buttons, a badge and a
badge effect, though they only show on the hovered or a new widget,
which added to the stall when opening it. Load them on demand instead.

CCBUG: 460992

shellprivate: look up applet icons with KIconLoader directly

QIcon::hasThemeIcon builds an icon engine and, when the applet has no
icon of its own, Qt then searches every theme directory a second time.
Asking KIconLoader directly does one cached lookup with the same result.

CCBUG: 460992

media.caption: Master, first open after plasmashell starts: plasmashell stops answering for 122 + 160 ms (328 ms blocked in total).
With the changes, same run: the stalls shrink to 59 + 118 ms (250 ms in total); a shorter freeze remains.

review.text: Two small, idiomatic optimisations that cut about 40% of the main-thread work when opening the sidebar: loading the per-delegate buttons and badge effect on demand with Loaders, and asking KIconLoader directly instead of QIcon::hasThemeIcon (same result under Plasma's platform theme). Both are partial improvements, honestly marked CCBUG, with measured before/after numbers and identical visuals in the screenshots. The Loader conversion keeps behaviour (the badge mask is rendered once on creation, buttons only exist for the current item), though the MR text should mention that a small creation cost now moves to hover.
